intent: medium-light roast - repeat of roast-20261030-001 on Mexico Mocabe HG, same conditions, to check repeatability
variable_changed: None intended (repeat). Batch size 223g vs 235g. Same plan: lid closed through first crack, opened at FC end, drop 90s after FC end.
